input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Admin, Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for alerts, clean expired alerts, compute. Secondary concerns include e-commerce functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As a Admin, I want to use compute capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to use data loader capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to use mail capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to use error handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
